The decision to place any repeat order shall be solely at th e discretion of KMRL. 23. Special Conditions:- 1) Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of the new batteries under the scope of the contractor. The contractor shall arrange all the battery accessories and tools re quired for installation. Work shall be carried out during Non-revenue hours under the s upervision of the KMRL engineer. 2) Old batteries against buyback will be handed over to the contractor in as it is conditi on, the contractor has to make necessary arrangements for taking the old batteries at their own risk and expense. Disconnection, removal and shifting of old batteries under the scope of the contract. 3) The bidder may visit the site to assess the site condition. 4) Old battery pickup needs to be done from muttom depot,which will be after the supp ly, testing & commissioning of new batteries. 5) The supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Batteries need to be complet ed within 60 days from the date of issuance of the PO. 6) The bidder shall submit the product data sheet, catalogue, or brochure along with th e bid, mentioning the specific model details for which they are bidding. 7) The bidder shall submit the type test certificate of the quoted model from a NABL-acc redited lab during bidding to verify the specification. 8) Three-year OEM warranty cards shall be supplied along with the invoice. The warrant y period will commence upon completion of Testing and Commissioning (T&C). 9) Valid OEM Authorisation/MAF/Dealership certificate issued by the OEM to be submitte d at the time of bidding. 10) Assembly and integration of the new battery bank with the existing UPS system, inclu ding supply of interconnecting copper cable jumpers with SS Nuts/Bolts/washers. 11) The bidder should have authorisation for the collection /recycling/refurbishment/dispo sal of lead acid batteries from the pollution control board/Agencies authorised by the p ollution control board. Proof of the same shall be submitted along with the bid.
